text: create a clone of the @world_loader.zig in typescript and swap out the /test route in @cart/hmsc-int/ for it, maybe it will perform as good as the zig native loader does also. which would be a big win if so
resolution: Same deliverable as req_1695 (its clarification): the original ask was to clone world_loader.zig in TS and swap /test for it; req_1695 clarified the intent was the DATA-LOAD path (not the V8 skip). Delivered under req_1695 — see that entry. New cart/hmsc-int/editors/play/tsLoader/ (decode.ts constructor twin, buildBuckets.ts, WorldLoaderView.tsx) + PlayTestRoute F3 toggle on /test. Verified by a 6/6 decode round-trip test and a clean cart bundle; headless load bench ~138ms/M instances.
